meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: Claude 在执行计算密集型任务前，会自动检测系统的 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等资源，生成一个含策略建议的 JSON 文件，并根据建议调整并行处理、内存策略或 GPU 加速。
howto.when: 当用户请求资源感知规划，或开始数据分析、模型训练、大规模文件处理等计算密集型任务前，Claude 会触发资源检测。

say.text: 帮我分析这个 50GB 的基因组数据集
say.note: 会检测内存是否够用，建议是否用 Dask/Zarr

say.text: 训练一个神经网络模型

say.note: 会检测 CPU 核心数并建议最优 worker 数

howto.what_en: Before computationally intensive tasks, Claude automatically detects system resources (CPU, GPU, memory, disk) and generates a JSON file with recommendations. It then adjusts parallel processing, memory strategy, or GPU acceleration based on these insights.
howto.when_en: When the user asks for resource-aware planning or starts a compute-heavy task like data analysis, model training, or large-scale file processing, Claude triggers resource detection.

say_en.note: Checks memory sufficiency; recommends Dask/Zarr if needed
Detects GPU type (NVIDIA/AMD/Apple) and suggests backend
Detects CPU cores and suggests optimal worker count
